  "pros": [
    "Intuitive interface and pre-designed templates make creating visual assignments quick and easy.",
    "Provides a wide range of visual elements and fonts suitable for engaging educational content.",
    "Eliminates the need for advanced design software, saving time and simplifying the process for a non-designer."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Advanced customization options can sometimes feel limited compared to professional design tools.",
    "Performance might occasionally slow down when working with many elements or high-resolution graphics.",
    "The free tier's limitations could be restrictive for frequent or complex class assignments, potentially requiring a subscription."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Assistant Band Director likely found Canva to be a highly valuable and user-friendly tool for creating class assignments. Its ease of use and rich template library significantly streamlined the design process, allowing them to produce visually appealing materials without prior design expertise. While they appreciated its core functionalities, they may have occasionally encountered limitations in deep customization or experienced minor performance issues with more complex projects."
